items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And I recorded with Julie London, as a matter of fact I had quite a few solos on her records, you know.

ctx.x: "People who live on the hill," Stardust. Beautiful, beautiful. Jimmie really wrote some beautiful things on (inaudible). And I recorded with Carmen in New York before I came out here. I think Ted Dameron did a date for her, and I recorded with her. And I recorded with Julie London, as a matter of fact I had quite a few solos on her records, you know. I think she was recording for Liberty then. I think the last one was "Body and Soul," that was the name of the album.
